cd /code && Rscript - <<'RS'
library(tidyverse)
d<-read_csv('../data/seer_merged_2000-2002_followup=15_2021-05-13.csv', col_types='ccddddddddd') %>% rename(age='Age', site='Site') %>% select(site, age, prevalence='Diagnosis.Rate', mortality='Death.Rate') %>% mutate(site=factor(site, levels=c('Breast','Colon and Rectum','Liver and Intrahepatic Bile Duct','Lung and Bronchus','Ovary','Pancreas')), age=sub('-[567]4', '', age), prevalence=sprintf('%5.2f', 100*prevalence), mortality=sprintf('%5.2f', 100*mortality)) %>% arrange(site, age) %>% rename('Tissue of origin'=site,'Age, y'=age,'5-year probability of diagnosis, %'=prevalence,'15-year probability of death, %'=mortality)
print(d %>% filter(`Tissue of origin`=='Breast', `Age, y`=='50'))
RS
